items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I'd be up there listening... J.P. Johnson, he would sit down and he'd play 32 choruses and not one the same.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, Duke was down there. J.P. Johnson, would play a number 32 choruses and not one chorus the same.
They tell me he was really great.
